commits.headline: Match 30 more US functions (11 net, 12 overlays, 4 core, 3 game) (#175)
commits.author: GarfTornion
commits.body:
* Match 12 more US functions (7 network, 2 game, 3 overlays)

Twelve functions of 64-168 bytes reconstructed from the retail code: seven
in network text, two in resident level text and three in level overlay code.
Each is exact against the US image under tools/audit_matches.py, and each was
checked by hand against retail's own symbols: every call target and every
global it reads or writes is the one the assembly names.

Eight carry their own compiler profile on the file's first line…
